ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Low ratio of high-intensity (white) to low-intensity (dark) pixels, estimated at approximately 1:15 across the visible surface area.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Contiguous high-intensity white blobs are localized at the distal tips of both lobes; a dense field of non-contiguous white stippling is mapped across the central and medial regions of the dark ventral surface.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: V-shaped central notch with an approximate interior pixel angle of 65 degrees and a deep vertical indentation relative to the posterior fluke margin.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Trailing edge exhibits moderate serration; the right lobe (as viewed) has a higher frequency of pixel-amplitude variations (jaggedness) compared to the smoother, lower-amplitude left lobe boundary.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: The trailing edges follow a sigmoidal trajectory characterized by an initial convexity transitioning into a concavity toward the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: High-contrast white pixel clusters (rosettes) are localized at the terminal ends of both lobes; small point-source white clusters are scattered across the mid-ventral plane.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Physical tissue irregularities and high-contrast scarring at the distal tips of both fluke lobes.
other_distinctive_markers: Extensive and highly distinct white-on-black stippling pattern distributed across the entire visible ventral surface.
